global_style: A dark-mode brutalist presentation template featuring high-contrast neon accents, oversized typography, visible grid lines, and text-as-texture techniques.

identity_anchors: Visible 1px thin grid lines defining asymmetrical structural panes
Oversized, bold geometric sans-serif typography contrasting with micro-copy
Repeating 'marquee' text bands used as borders or background textures
Solid accent circles and transparent colored geometric overlays

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
